notes: KYE does NOT run the agent (§0.30/§32 non-competition vs LangChain/CrewAI/OpenAI Agents SDK/Claude Agent SDK/Bedrock). KYE queries the AWS Bedrock AgentCore agent-gateway/identity control point over the remote-http transport, maps the AgentCore admit/deny (with guardrail obligations carried through) onto a KYE DecisionOutcome, and seals the raw AgentCore verdict into a Replay-Proof Evidence Pack — so an AgentCore-run agent becomes an authority-resolved, replay-verifiable principal. allow_maps_to is allow_with_constraints because the AgentCore guardrail layer routinely returns obligations that KYE carries onto the Decision Map. AWS is an external runtime integrated by clean contract (§0.28); the live gateway binding is supplied by the adopter at deploy time.
